name: dhun-web
description: DHUN in the browser: a working music player for the web — JioSaavn search and playback through the public saavn.dev API, no account, no DHUN server, library stored on the device. Ships no runtime dependency.

comments.dependencies: None, deliberately. The app ships no runtime dependency: no framework, no CDN, no icon library, no webfont, no analytics. Dev tooling is Node's own (http, test runner, zlib) for the same reason.
